cc:Work.dc:title: GateBench model-study acceptance
cc:Work.dc:description: GateBench primary-study verifier acceptance and full-check repeated-trial consistency. Each model has 12 tasks and 3 repeats. Whiskers are task-cluster 95% confidence intervals. Verifier acceptance is not independent ground truth.

g.text: GateBench primary study · 72 local model trials · same model family and Q4_K_M quantization

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #53636f

g.text: Each model: 12 tasks × 3 repeats = 36 trials. Whiskers: task-cluster 95% percentile CIs (2,000 resamples; seed 17).

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #53636f

g.text: Acceptance measures agreement with an encoded verifier, not independently established correctness. Zero-width intervals reflect this sample only.
